character.helena.title: Smart and karate-strong
character.helena.perks: Yellow belt, strong Kiai, precision slingshot.
character.helena.quip1: I read the book on it. And the book about the book.
character.helena.quip2: Yellow belt, calm breathing. Bullies, please queue up behind.
character.helena.quip3: Aiming is physics with style. I checked the math.
character.kilian.title: The Wild Genius
character.kilian.perks: Big tricks, throws the stick far. Forgets the homework.
character.kilian.quip1: A plan? I've got 14 plans and wrote none of them down!
character.kilian.quip2: Homework? Did it! ...somewhere. In a backpack. Probably.
character.kilian.quip3: Skateboard, chaos, genius – in that order, bro.
character.lorenz.title: The Sunshine Kid
character.lorenz.perks: Grabs buses, talks his way out, music and art bonus.
character.lorenz.quip1: Today is going to be the best day ever, I can feel it!
character.lorenz.quip2: Bus gone? I'll wave so nicely it turns around.
character.lorenz.quip3: I'm the youngest, but with the most energy. Let's go!

learning.react.wrong.1: Just missed, happens to the best.
learning.react.wrong.2: Oops, we will remember that for later.
learning.react.wrong.3: No worries, next time it works.
learning.react.wrong.4: Almost, bro! Have a look at the explanation.
learning.react.streak.1: Three in a row, you are on fire!
teacher.comment.01: A kid with brains and a bike bell: keep it up and the rocket to the next grade is fuelled!
teacher.comment.02: Every day you got a little smarter. Even my coffee noticed.
teacher.comment.03: Learning is like skating: first it wobbles, then it rolls. Yours is rolling quite nicely!
teacher.comment.04: A school run full of adventures and you still made it to class. Respect!
teacher.comment.05: You have humour, courage and a great backpack. The learning is catching up nicely.
teacher.comment.06: The class would be a lot quieter and much less fun without you.
teacher.comment.07: Mistakes are just stops on the way to the right answer. You already know many stations!
teacher.comment.08: Stamina takes you far, and you have plenty of it. Stay on it!
teacher.comment.09: One top mark after another? I think my red pen has asked for a holiday.
teacher.comment.10: A seriously strong performance! You prove that learning and fun are best friends.
teacher.comment.11: If there was a trophy for brainpower, you would need to clear some shelf space.
teacher.comment.12: Smart and kind: that combination is rare. You are a real stroke of luck for the class!
teacher.comment.13: Solid marks, great pace. With a little more courage to raise your hand you can easily do even more.
teacher.comment.14: You are on a really good track. A few more steps and those marks will sparkle.
teacher.comment.15: Not the loudest, not the quietest, but always in. I like that a lot.
teacher.comment.16: Some tasks are tough nuts. You cracked them anyway, or at least gave them a good nibble!
teacher.comment.17: Everybody learns at their own pace. Yours is taking a run-up, and that looks like a big jump.
teacher.comment.18: I thought of you and of an extra portion of practice. Together we will manage!
teacher.comment.19: A report card is only a snapshot. The next photo will look great, promise!
teacher.comment.20: In maths you calculate as if you had a calculator in your head. The times-table boss respects you!
teacher.comment.21: In German you know exactly whether it is der, die or das. The word types bow to you!
teacher.comment.22: Your English is really cool, mate! Even the signs around town read like child's play to you.
teacher.comment.23: In general studies you are as sharp as a satnav with a brain: maps, traffic, nature, you know it all!
teacher.comment.24: In science your knowledge sparks and shines. Circuits, magnets, plants: you are a little researcher!
teacher.comment.25: Maths and you are not best friends yet, but a few rounds of times tables and you will soon share all your secrets.
teacher.comment.26: German can be a bit moody, I know. With some practice on der, die, das it turns into a nice friendship.
teacher.comment.27: English sometimes sounds like a secret language. A few more words and you will crack the code!
teacher.comment.28: General studies has as many twists and turns as your school run. Study the map a little longer and you will find your way!
teacher.comment.29: Science is a little puzzle sometimes. Try a few more experiments and soon it will click, like a switch!
teacher.comment.30: You improved so much that I had to look at the marks twice. Bravo!
teacher.comment.31: Step by step upwards: that is how learning works. I am really proud of you!
teacher.comment.32: Your curve points up like a skater flying out of the halfpipe. Keep going!
teacher.comment.33: The marks may not be at the top yet, but you are the rocket of the class: nobody has learned as much as you!
teacher.comment.34: You help wherever you can, and you are tidy and friendly. That makes the class a better place.
teacher.comment.35: A kid whose homework even arrives on time. A small miracle, thank you!
teacher.comment.36: You are as helpful as a superhero without the cape. Great that you are here!
teacher.comment.37: There is room to grow in tidiness and behaviour, but I know you can do it. A little red-light patience works wonders!
teacher.comment.38: Your backpack and your homework are welcome to meet more often. Otherwise you are a really great person!
teacher.comment.39: A little more calm and order, and your ideas and your energy become a superpower!
parent.promoted.01: Awesome, you made it to the next grade! We are really proud of you.
parent.promoted.02: We have to celebrate this! Ice cream today for the new report card.
parent.promoted.03: You did it! You studied so hard, and now it is there in black and white.
parent.promoted.04: Wow, I am showing this to Grandma right away! Bring on grade four.
parent.promoted.05: Just like that, sweetheart. You can handle anything you set your mind to!
parent.promoted.06: Big praise for you. Tonight you may pick the dinner!
parent.promoted.07: We are so happy. You gave your best, and it paid off.
parent.promoted.08: Brilliant report card! We are putting it on the fridge, right at the top.
parent.promoted.09: I am so proud I almost run out of words. Almost!
parent.promoted.10: You fought and won, like a little hero. Keep going!
parent.promoted.11: Respect, champ! The holidays are well deserved.
parent.promoted.12: Thanks for sticking with it. That was a really strong year!
parent.repeat.01: Hey, no drama. We will do a bonus lap, and we are right by your side.
parent.repeat.02: We love you, with or without a report card. Next year will be your year!
parent.repeat.03: A second lap means you already know all the tricks. This is going to be great!
parent.repeat.04: You learned a lot, we can see that. Now there is even more time to shine.
parent.repeat.05: Chin up, champ! We will practise together, and there will be pizza.
parent.repeat.06: Every hero needs a second run-up sometimes. We believe in you!
parent.repeat.07: The report card does not say how great you are. We know that ourselves.
parent.repeat.08: With the comeback bonus you start the new year really strong. Let us go!
parent.repeat.09: We are proud that you do not give up. That is worth more than any mark.
parent.repeat.10: A new chance, a new swing. And we are your fan club!
parent.repeat.11: Come here, a hug first. Then we plan your comeback.
parent.repeat.12: You will surely nail it the second time, and then you are the pro of the class!
grades.reason.promoted: Promoted! On to the next grade!
grades.reason.average: The average is still a little off target, but with some practice you will catch up easily.
grades.reason.fives: A few subjects still need some love. A bonus lap will make you really strong there.
grades.reason.noGrades: No marks yet. Let us get learning!

minigame.quit.toast: All good, next time will go better!
minigame.waiting: Done! Just waiting for the others.
minigame.quiz-demo.title: Quiz (demo)
minigame.sprint-demo.title: Sprint (demo)
minigame.mathe.title: Math Arena
minigame.mathe.help.sprint: Calculate in your head! Pick with keys 1-4, arrows + Enter or tap. Type numbers on the keypad.
minigame.mathe.help.blocks: The answer blocks are falling! Catch the right one: move with the arrows and press Enter, keys 1-4 or tap.
minigame.mathe.timeout: Too slow, the blocks landed. No stress!
minigame.mathe.winner: {name} is ahead! You are both really strong!
minigame.mathe.tie: A tie! A true genius team!
minigame.deutsch.title: German Workshop
minigame.deutsch.help.belt: The word rides the belt! Sort it into the right bin: der (blue, square), die (red, circle), das (green, triangle). Arrows + Enter, keys 1-3 or tap.
minigame.deutsch.help.spell: Become a spelling detective! Pick the answer with keys 1-4, arrows + Enter or tap. Type words on the letter pad or with your keyboard.
minigame.deutsch.beltPrompt: Which article goes with this word? Into the right bin!
minigame.deutsch.timeout: Too slow, the word slid off the belt. No stress!
minigame.deutsch.winner: {name} is ahead! You are both language pros!
minigame.deutsch.tie: A tie! A true detective duo!
minigame.englisch.title: English Club
minigame.englisch.help.memory: Find the pairs! Flip two cards: an English word (blue, EN) and its German meaning (yellow, DE). Arrows + Enter or tap.
minigame.englisch.help.signs: What does the sign say? Pick the meaning with keys 1-4, arrows + Enter or tap. Some words you type on the letter pad.
minigame.englisch.signAsk: Was heißt das? / What does it mean?
minigame.englisch.winner: {name} is ahead! You are both English stars!
minigame.englisch.tie: A tie! A real dream team, bro!
minigame.erdkunde.title: Geography Expedition
minigame.erdkunde.help.wo: Tap the right state or river on the map. With the keyboard, arrows jump from place to place and Enter picks.
minigame.erdkunde.help.capital: The state glows on the map. What is its capital? Keys 1-4, arrows + Enter or tap.
minigame.erdkunde.winner: {name} is ahead! You are both map pros!
minigame.erdkunde.tie: A tie! A true explorer duo!
minigame.science.title: Science Lab
minigame.science.help.sort: Drag the card into the right test tube or tap a tube. With the keyboard: arrows + Enter or key 1-4, arrow up gives a hint.
minigame.science.help.circuit: The bulb is off! Tap the part that stops the current. With the keyboard: arrows + Enter or key 1-5.
minigame.science.circuit.ask: The bulb is off! Tap what stops the current.
minigame.science.circuit.partial: Nice one! One more spot is still stuck.
minigame.science.circuit.lit: The bulb is on! The current can flow around the loop.
minigame.science.why.battery: The battery is fine, it supplies the current. The problem is somewhere else.
minigame.science.why.bulb: The bulb is fine. It only lights once current gets through.
minigame.science.why.wire: The wire conducts just fine. Look for the spot where the current gets stuck.
minigame.science.why.switch-closed: The switch is already closed, so the current zips through.
minigame.science.why.bridge-ok: {item} conducts current already. The problem is somewhere else.
minigame.science.why.extra: Nothing is broken here. Current only flows when the whole loop is closed.
minigame.science.winner: {name} is ahead! You are both real scientists!
minigame.science.tie: A tie! Two geniuses at work!
minigame.headline.4: Made it! Next time there is even more in you.
minigame.headline.5: Practice makes perfect, you will get there!
minigame.headline.6: No stress, let us try again right away.
minigame.react.great.1: Your brain is on fire, dude!
minigame.react.good.2: Not bad, bro. There is still more in you!
minigame.react.ok.1: Half of it sticks, the other half is still on break.
minigame.react.ok.2: Solid. Your brain is just warming up.
minigame.react.low.1: Your brain still has a loading bar. Back in a sec!
minigame.react.low.2: Not your day today, tomorrow is a new one.
minigame.react.zero.1: Counts as a warm-up round. The second one will be better!
minigame.react.zero.2: Do not worry, even geniuses start at zero.
minigame.musik.title: Beat Stage
minigame.musik.help: Tap in time when the notes touch the line! Player 1: A S W D or 1-4, player 2: arrows or numpad 1-4. Or tap the lanes. No sound needed: the ring shows the beat.
minigame.musik.winner: {name} rocks the stage! You are both stars!
minigame.kunst.title: Pixel Studio
minigame.kunst.help: Remember the pixel pattern, it will vanish soon! Then paint it again: arrows move, Enter paints (hold it and move to draw strokes), key 1-4 picks a colour, arrow down opens the colour palette. Or paint with the mouse or a finger.
minigame.kunst.paintHint: Enter paints, arrow down: colours and Done
minigame.kunst.result.perfect: A perfect copy! You have a camera in your head!
minigame.kunst.result.ok: Nice! {n} of {total} cells. The next one will be even better.
minigame.kunst.result.low: Bold painting! {n} of {total} cells. The next pattern gives you more time.
minigame.kunst.winner: {name} has the sharpest eye! You are both artists!
minigame.sport.title: Gym: Obstacle Course
minigame.sport.help: Obstacle course! Run with the arrows or WASD, Shift sprints (your stamina is limited), Space jumps over hurdles. Weave around the cones and stay on the beam. Fast and clean means the most points!
minigame.sport.section.sprint: Sprint! Shift steps on the gas!
minigame.sport.knock.beam: Wobble! The mat catches you. +{t} s
minigame.sport.tired: Out of breath! Take a moment.
minigame.sport.timeout: Time is up! You reached station {n} of {total}. Next time you will make it!
minigame.sport.result.ok: Solid round, you can go faster.
minigame.sport.result.low: You hung in there! That counts, training makes you fit.
minigame.sport.winner: {name} is the fastest! You are both sports stars!
minigame.sport.tie: A tie! A real dream team!

stick.pinataBurst: The pinata bursts! Candy for everyone, bro!
loot.sticker: A sticker! Into the album it goes.
loot.homework: The lost homework notebook! Take it to the teacher.

toast.defenseHintTouch: Tip: the shield button blocks, the Kiai button shouts!
toast.defenseHintPad: Tip: X blocks, click the right stick for the Kiai!
dojo.sign: Little Dragon Dojo: learn calm, respect and courage. Come on in!
dojo.hint: Talk to the sensei (Interact) to train.
dojo.sensei.greet.1: A true fighter is one who never has to fight.
dojo.sensei.greet.2: Breathe calmly, Little Dragon. Whoever stays calm has half won already.
dojo.sensei.greet.3: Respect is the first thing in the dojo – and the last thing we forget.
dojo.sensei.greet.4: If someone teases you: deep breath, straight back, Kiai – and then just walk on!
dojo.sensei.greet.5: Courage does not mean being loud. It means staying kind when it is hard.
dojo.sensei.greet.6: You can tie on a belt. But respect you have to earn!
dojo.sensei.greet.7: My secret? I grin while I block. Try it, it works!
dojo.sensei.greet.8: Helena already wears the yellow belt. And you? Practice, practice, breathe!
dojo.sensei.start: Bow, breathe, and off we go!
dojo.sensei.after.1: Well done! And remember: the most important part was the breathing.
dojo.sensei.after.2: A dragon does not grow up in a day. But you will!
dojo.sensei.after.3: Nice and calm. That is how karate goes.
dojo.sensei.closed.1: The dojo is closed for today. Even dragons need sleep. Come back tomorrow!
dojo.sensei.closed.2: Enough training for today! Muscles grow while you sleep. See you tomorrow!
minigame.karate.title: Dojo: Karate Training
minigame.karate.help: The sensei calls the moves, you play them in time! Dodge: left / right. Block: up / down or the block key. Kiai: the Kiai key. Or tap the lanes. Staying calm fills the focus!
karate.belt.yellow.line: New belt! You are yellow now – like a banana, but with style!
karate.belt.orange.line: New belt! You are orange now – like a tangerine, only without the pips!
karate.belt.green.line: New belt! You are green now – like a frog, but without the croaking!
karate.belt.blue.line: New belt! You are blue now – as calm as a lake in summer!
karate.unlock.white: The basics: block, dodge and Kiai.
karate.unlock.yellow: Yellow belt: your dodge roll goes farther now!
karate.unlock.orange: Orange belt: your Kiai reaches much farther now!
karate.unlock.green: Green belt: perfect parries give you courage back!
karate.unlock.blue: Blue belt: the Calming Aura! Anyone who wants to tease you needs longer to recover.

hint.browse.heading: Help and tips
hint.browse.nav: Left / right: next tip   {keys} or Esc: close
hint.welcome.title: Welcome to Schulweg!
hint.welcome.body: Ride, skate or walk through town and reach school before 8 o'clock. Move with {move}, sprint with {sprint}, jump with {jump}. Press {interact} to use things: climb on and off a bike or open a door. Map: {map}. Pause and help: {pause}.
hint.bike.title: Your bike
hint.bike.body: You are on your bike! Press {interact} to get on or off. {jump} rings the bell and walkers step aside. Bikes are fastest on the road and the cycle lane, and slow on grass.
hint.skateboard.title: Skateboard
hint.skateboard.body: Press {jump} for an ollie. Hold {manual} to balance on two wheels in a manual. Tricks on ramps and rails give you Style points, and tricks in a row build a combo.
hint.skates.title: Roller skates
hint.skates.body: Skates are fast but slippery. Stay close behind a bus and hold {interact} to grab on and get pulled along. Let go to stop. Cobblestones slow skates down a lot.
hint.wheels.title: Scooter and inline skates
hint.wheels.body: Scooters and inline skates are quick on smooth asphalt and cycle lanes. Cobblestones and grass slow them down a lot, so pick your route. {interact} gets you off again.
hint.tricks.title: Nice trick!
hint.tricks.body: Tricks earn Style points. Do several tricks one after another to keep a combo going. Ramps, rails and the skatepark are the best places to practise.
hint.locked.title: Not yours yet
hint.locked.body: Vehicles with a padlock are locked. You can only ride a vehicle after you own it. Until then you can walk or ride your bike.
hint.chase.title: A bully spotted you!
hint.chase.body: When a bully sees you, the chase starts and your Ärger bar fills up. Run away with {move} and sprint with {sprint}, or hide in a bush or another hiding spot and stay completely still until they lose you. Move to leave your hiding spot.
hint.defense.title: Defend yourself
hint.defense.body: Hold {defend} to block. Press it while you walk to dodge to the side. Press {kiai} for a loud Kiai shout: the bully stumbles and backs off. Karate and tools never hurt anyone.
hint.caught.title: Caught!
hint.caught.body: A bully got you. You lose a little pocket money and wake up back at home. Next time run away, hide or defend yourself!
hint.tools.title: Your tools
hint.tools.body: You found ammo! Switch tools with {toolPrev} and {toolNext}, and use the tool with {toolUse}. Aim with the mouse or the right stick. Tools never hurt people or animals: try them on targets and piñatas.
hint.traffic.title: Watch the road
hint.traffic.body: Buses and other traffic can knock you over, and you lose a few coins. Look before you cross and stay on pavements and cycle lanes when you can.
hint.rain.title: It is raining
hint.rain.body: Puddles are slippery and slow you down. Ride around them and take it easy on wet roads. The rain stops after a while.
commute.late: {who} is {min} minutes late. The teacher smiles: better late than never!
commute.ontime: {who} arrives right on time. Well done!
tram.arrived: Ticket stamped. The tram ride is over.
tram.freeRide: You rode without a ticket and nobody checked. Lucky!
tram.inspector: The ticket inspector caught {who} without a ticket: a small fine and a friendly reminder.
hint.commute.title: Three ways to school
hint.commute.body: Be at school before 8:00! Main road: fast and straight, but with buses and traffic. Park route: quiet, but the cobblestones are bumpy and the skatepark is bully turf. Tram: from the stop near home to the stop at school, but you need a ticket. Coins lie along the way.
hint.tram.title: Tram ride
hint.tram.body: At a tram stop press {interact} to ride to the other stop. A ticket costs a little money. If you cannot pay you ride without a ticket, and an inspector might catch you.

item.ring-gold.name: Golden glow ring
item.ring-gold.desc: A golden ring that shines under your feet.
item.snack-roll.name: Fresh roll

item.snack-juice.name: Apple juice

mission.parcel.title: Parcel delivery
mission.parcel.intro: Brrring! It is Mrs. Wendt. She forgot a parcel at the bakery and has a sore knee. Could you bring it to her at the park?
mission.parcel.step1: Pick up the parcel at the bakery
mission.parcel.step2: Bring the parcel to Mrs. Wendt at the park bench
mission.parcel.done: Mrs. Wendt beams: Thank you, you are a star! Here is something for your trouble.
mission.stolen-bike.title: Bike rescue
mission.stolen-bike.intro: Oh no! A bully borrowed your bike. Follow the arrow to the hideout and ride it back home!
mission.stolen-bike.step1: Get your bike back from the hideout
mission.stolen-bike.done: Got it! Your bike is back with you. That was brave.
mission.grandma.title: Groceries for Grandma
mission.grandma.intro: Grandma called: she needs groceries, and eggs! Careful, every bump can break eggs. You can lose three before they are all gone.
mission.grandma.step1: Pick up the groceries at the market
mission.grandma.step2: Bring the groceries to Grandma in the old town
mission.grandma.hit: Crack! {n} eggs left. Take it slower!
mission.grandma.fail: All the eggs are broken. Grandma says: no problem, try again!
mission.grandma.done: Grandma hugs you: what a careful delivery! Here is a treat for you.
mission.lost-homework.title: The lost homework
mission.lost-homework.intro: Your homework flew away in the wind! Search the park: use your stick to rummage through bushes and piles of leaves.
mission.lost-homework.step1: Search the park with your stick
mission.lost-homework.done: Your homework is saved! Your teacher is very proud of you.
mission.skate-race.title: Skate race
mission.skate-race.intro: Race call from the skatepark! Ride a skateboard, skates, scooter or inline skates through all four gates before the time runs out. The winner gets a scooter.
mission.skate-race.step1: Roll to the start line in the skatepark
mission.skate-race.step2: Ride through all the gates on wheels, fast!
mission.skate-race.fail: Time is up! You were close. Come back to the start line and try again.
mission.skate-race.done: Winner! The whole skatepark cheers for you.
mission.bike-race.title: Bike race
mission.bike-race.intro: The cycle lane race is on! Ride your bike through all the gates along the road before the time runs out. The winner gets inline skates.
mission.bike-race.step1: Ride to the start line on the cycle lane
mission.bike-race.step2: Ride through all the gates on your bike, fast!
mission.bike-race.fail: Time is up! Take a breath and try again from the start line.
mission.kirmes-range.title: Kirmes shooting range
mission.kirmes-range.intro: The fair is in town! At the stall you can win a prize: knock over five cans with your slingshot. Only the cans count, never people or animals.
mission.kirmes-range.step1: Go to the fair stall in the park
mission.kirmes-range.step2: Knock over five cans with your slingshot
mission.kirmes-range.done: Bullseye! The stall owner hands you your prize.
mission.friendship-1.title: A peace offering
mission.friendship-1.intro: The big kid at the skatepark always looks lonely. Maybe a little sweet treat would help? Collect two candies and bring them over.
mission.friendship-1.step1: Collect two candies from bushes and crates
mission.friendship-1.step2: Bring the candies to the skatepark
mission.friendship-1.done: The big kid grins: Thanks! He chases you a little less now.
mission.friendship-2.title: Homework help
mission.friendship-2.intro: The big kid has trouble with his homework. Why not show him what you learned? Finish a lesson at school first.
mission.friendship-2.step2: Take what you learned to the schoolyard
mission.friendship-2.done: The big kid understands it now. He waves instead of chasing you.
mission.friendship-3.title: A game together
mission.friendship-3.intro: Time to make it official: invite the big kid to play in the park. Ring your bike bell three times so everybody hears the invitation.
mission.friendship-3.done: Now you are friends! Bullies leave you alone far more often.

sticker.bee.name: Honeybee
sticker.bee.fact: A honeybee can fly about 25 kilometres per hour.
sticker.octopus.name: Octopus
sticker.cow.name: Cow
sticker.cow.fact: A cow has a stomach with four parts.
sticker.elephant.name: Elephant
sticker.elephant.fact: An elephant's trunk has no bones at all, only muscles.
sticker.ice.name: Floating ice
sticker.ice.fact: Ice floats on water because frozen water is lighter than liquid water.
sticker.rainbow.name: Rainbow
sticker.rainbow.fact: A rainbow is really a full circle. From the ground you only see a part of it.
sticker.sunlight.name: Sunlight
sticker.sunlight.fact: Sunlight needs about eight minutes to travel to the Earth.
sticker.magnet.name: Compass
sticker.magnet.fact: The Earth acts like a giant magnet. That is why a compass works.
sticker.plants.name: Green leaves
sticker.plants.fact: Plants make oxygen from sunlight, water and air, and we breathe it.
sticker.zugspitze.name: Zugspitze
sticker.zugspitze.fact: The Zugspitze is the highest mountain in Germany: 2,962 metres.
sticker.rhine.name: River Rhine
sticker.rhine.fact: The Rhine flows through or along six countries on its way to the sea.
sticker.wadden.name: Wadden Sea
sticker.wadden.fact: On the North Sea coast the sea goes away twice a day at low tide, and you can walk on the sea floor.
sticker.blackforest.name: Black Forest
sticker.blackforest.fact: Cuckoo clocks come from the Black Forest in Germany.
sticker.football.name: Football
sticker.football.fact: A football match has two halves of 45 minutes each.
sticker.zebra.name: Zebra crossing
sticker.zebra.fact: A zebra crossing is named after the black and white stripes of a zebra.
sticker.pretzel.name: Pretzel
sticker.pretzel.fact: Bakers in Germany have baked pretzels for many centuries.
sticker.chicken.name: Hen
sticker.chicken.fact: A hen can lay around 250 eggs in one year.
sticker.pencil.name: Pencil
sticker.pencil.fact: One pencil can draw a line more than 50 kilometres long.
sticker.owl.name: Owl
sticker.owl.fact: An owl can turn its head about 270 degrees.
sticker.skateboard.name: Skateboard
sticker.skateboard.fact: The first skateboards were made of wooden boards with roller skate wheels.
sticker.bicycle.name: First bicycle
sticker.bicycle.fact: The first bicycle, invented in Germany, had no pedals: you pushed it along with your feet.
sticker.lightning.name: Lightning
sticker.lightning.fact: Lightning is hotter than the surface of the sun.
sticker.dog.name: Dog nose
sticker.dog.fact: Every dog has its own nose print, a bit like your fingerprint.
sticker.cat.name: Cat
sticker.cat.fact: A cat sleeps 12 to 16 hours a day.
sticker.penguin.name: Penguin
sticker.penguin.fact: Penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers.
sticker.tram.name: Tram
sticker.tram.fact: The first electric tram in the world ran in Berlin in 1881.
sticker.giraffe.name: Giraffe
sticker.giraffe.fact: A giraffe has just seven neck bones, the same number as you.
sticker.brandenburg.name: Brandenburg Gate
sticker.brandenburg.fact: The Brandenburg Gate in Berlin is more than 230 years old.
sticker.snail.name: Garden snail
sticker.snail.fact: A garden snail has thousands of tiny teeth.

parent.age.explain: The challenge age sets how hard the questions and how tight the times are for one child, on top of the learning difficulty above. It starts with the age of the character and can be changed without changing the character. The questions stay for class 3 and keep adapting to the answers.

grownup.janitor.caught: The janitor sighs: Please walk, and pick up that coin you dropped. (A little money is gone.)

grownup.inspector.shout: The ticket inspector: Hold on! Let me see your ticket!
grownup.inspector.caught: The inspector: Next time buy a ticket, please. Then everything is fine.
grownup.inspector.calm: The inspector tips his cap and walks away.
